evidence: PerfDataNotAvailableError defined in sdk/errors.py:46 ('Raised when required performance data is missing or unsupported for a requested mode'). Raised in sdk/perf_database.py:1005 and :1010 when the perf DB has no rows for a model/system/backend combination; docstring at :1001 says the combination 'is not supported by AIC in SILICON mode'. SILICON is the default DatabaseMode (perf_database.py:1419). Mechanism confirmed; note the error is a generic per-op data-miss, not specifically 'encoder' data, but a system lacking encoder perf rows triggers exactly this raise.
